Alcuni anti-cheat bloccano i giochi quan: Some anti-cheats block games when Gaming Mode acts on the keyboard, windows or processes.
Mentre è aperto un gioco con anti-cheat,: While a game with anti-cheat is open, Gaming Mode pauses the volume keys, borderless windows, cursor hiding and the game's power management. They resume when you close the game.
Sospende le stesse funzioni con qualunqu: Pauses the same features for any game, even when no anti-cheat is recognized.
Un eseguibile per riga, ad esempio cod.e: One executable per line, for example cod.exe
Il registro di Gaming Mode (%APPDATA%\\G: The Gaming Mode log (%APPDATA%\GamingMode\agent.log) shows when protection turns on and why.
Apri la Dashboard con il controller: Open the Dashboard with your controller
Core non legge il controller: lo gestisc: Core doesn't read the controller: Steam handles it. In Steam, assign a Guide button chord to the Dashboard's keyboard shortcut.
1. Apri gli accordi del tasto Guida con: 1. Open the Guide button chords with the button below, or in Steam: Settings > Controller > Guide Button Chord Layout > Edit.
2. Scegli un tasto libero, ad esempio Y,: 2. Pick a free button, for example Y, and assign it the keyboard key P.
3. Nelle opzioni di quel comando aggiung: 3. In that command's options, add Left Ctrl and Left Alt as extra commands, so a single press sends Ctrl + Alt + P.
4. Tieni premuto il tasto Guida e premi: 4. Hold the Guide button and press Y: the Dashboard opens, even in game.
Apri gli accordi del tasto Guida in Stea: Open the Guide button chords in Steam
Steam non ha aperto gli accordi del tast: Steam didn't open the Guide button chords. Follow the steps from Settings > Controller.
La scorciatoia da tastiera della Dashboa: The Dashboard keyboard shortcut is turned off.
Core di Eternal. Basato su Playhub di An: Core by Eternal. Based on Playhub by Andrea Sgarro (LoZazaMastro), MIT licence. © 2026 Andrea Sgarro (LoZazaMastro).
All'accensione e al risveglio mostra il: At power-on and on wake, shows the Eternal logo and then Core's before Big Picture. Any controller button skips it.
Circa sette secondi su sfondo nero. Non: About seven seconds on a black background. It never delays Steam: if anything goes wrong, Gaming Mode starts anyway.
Il suono arcade che accompagna la sequen: The arcade sound that goes with the sequence.
Core accende la TV e passa al suo ingres: Core turns the TV on and switches to its input when it enters Gaming Mode, and turns it off when Core sleeps or shuts down.
Spegni la TV con Core: Turn the TV off with Core
Quando Core va in sospensione o si spegn: When Core sleeps or shuts down, it turns the TV off only if the TV is showing Core. If someone is watching something else, the TV stays on.
Sulla TV attiva Impostazioni > Generali: On the TV, turn on Settings > General > Mobile TV On > Turn on via Wi-Fi, and Quick Start+. When pairing for the first time, accept the prompt on the TV with the remote.
The Gaming Mode service is not responding.
Nessuna TV LG trovata in rete. Inserisci: No LG TV found on the network. Enter the IP address by hand.
Enter the TV's IP address first.
Accetta la richiesta sulla TV con il tel: Accept the prompt on the TV with the remote.
Pairing was declined on the TV.
La richiesta sulla TV non è stata accett: The prompt on the TV was not accepted in time.
La TV non risponde. Controlla che sia ac: The TV is not responding. Check that it is on and on the same network.
Se i plugin di Big Picture non si carica: If Big Picture's plugins don't load, Core says so with a short notice. Core Repair, in your Steam library, fixes them with the controller, even without Decky.
Un messaggio breve sopra Big Picture, ma: A short message over Big Picture, never during a game. Steam and your games keep working either way.
Aggiornamento di Steam avviato. Core sal: Steam update started. Core first saves a copy of Steam and will be back in a few minutes.
Steam resta a questa versione ancora per: Steam stays on this version for {0} more days, or until you choose to update it.
Trenta giorni passati: Core aggiornerà S: Thirty days are up: Core will update Steam the next time you're not playing.
Core tiene ferma la versione di Steam fi: Core keeps Steam on its current version until you choose, for at most 30 days. Before updating it saves a copy of Steam and checks that plugins come back; if they break, you can roll back.
Spegne le interruzioni di Windows che po: Turns off the Windows interruptions that can reach the TV. Every change is saved first and can be undone here.
Nascondi gli avvisi di Windows in Gaming: Hide Windows notifications in Gaming Mode
Niente banner di Windows sulla TV; torna: No Windows banners on the TV; they come back on the desktop and stay in the notification centre. Steam and Decky notifications are unchanged.
Gli aggiornamenti di Windows aspettano l: Windows updates wait for the night: when a restart is needed, Quick Access > Core offers to restart at 5:00.
The changes could not be applied.
Applicato. Windows ha chiesto i permessi: Applied. Windows asked for administrator permission for the PC settings.
Le impostazioni dell'utente sono applica: Your user settings are applied; the PC settings need administrator permission.
Le impostazioni dell'utente sono annulla: Your user settings are undone; the PC settings need administrator permission.
Nessuna schermata \"Completiamo la confi: No "Let's finish setting up" screens after updates
Niente consigli, suggerimenti e pubblici: No Windows tips, suggestions or ads
Niente finestre Tasti permanenti, filtro: No Sticky, Filter or Toggle Keys pop-ups
Le chiamate vocali non abbassano il volu: Voice calls do not lower the volume of games and music
Nessun riavvio per gli aggiornamenti men: No update restarts while you're signed in
Windows Update non cambia il driver graf: Windows Update leaves the graphics driver alone
Niente richieste di Edge al primo avvio: No Edge first-run or default-browser prompts
Accesso rapido > Core mostra se backup,: Quick Access > Core shows whether backups, the server, the TV and the PC are fine.
Il nome del server di casa, per esempio: The home server's name, for example serverv3. Core reads the backup status from Home Assistant on that server.
Un breve avviso in Gaming Mode se il bac: A short notice in Gaming Mode when the backup fails two nights in a row, the server's drive reports a problem or the server has been silent for more than a day and a half. At most once a day, never during a game.
Modalità streaming attiva: Core lascia s: Stream mode is on: Core leaves the TV alone.
Questa versione di Decky richiede il nuo: This Decky version needs the new Steam client, which this PC doesn't have yet. Decky stays at the installed version.
Questo Steam usa il nuovo client, che De: This Steam uses the new client, which Decky 3 can't load. Decky 4 is needed: Decky stays at the installed version.
Core lascia passare qualche giorno da og: Core lets each new Steam version wait a few days, checks that it gets along with Decky and installs it at night, when you're not playing. It saves a copy of Steam first and, if something stops working after the update, rolls back by itself.
Giorni di attesa per una nuova versione: Days to wait for a new Steam version
C'è una nuova versione di Steam: Core la: There's a new Steam version: Core installs it in {0} days, at night, if it gets along with Decky.
Core aggiornerà Steam la prossima notte: Core will update Steam on the next update night, if you're not playing.
il nuovo Steam non funziona con la versi: the new Steam doesn't work with the installed Decky.
Core non sa ancora se il nuovo Steam fun: Core can't tell yet whether the new Steam works with Decky.
Core non riesce a verificare la compatib: Core can't check compatibility with Decky.
L'ultimo aggiornamento di Steam non ha s: The last Steam update failed its check and was undone. Core tries again when a fix arrives.
Core non sa se il nuovo Steam funziona c: Core can't tell whether the new Steam works with Decky. Press again to update anyway: Core saves a copy first and rolls back if something goes wrong.
Il nuovo Steam non funziona con la versi: The new Steam doesn't work with the installed Decky: plugins will stop loading. Press again if you want to update anyway.
Ultima conferma: premi ancora una volta: Last confirmation: press once more to update Steam knowing that plugins won't work.
Core controlla che il PC del salotto non: Core checks that the living-room PC never asks for a keyboard, mouse or password and that the TV stays right. The status is in Quick Access > Core > Health.
Rimanda dietro la Big Picture le finestr: Push launcher windows behind Big Picture
Quando Epic, EA app, Ubisoft Connect, l': When Epic, EA app, Ubisoft Connect, the Xbox app or Battle.net open by themselves over Big Picture and you are not playing, Core moves them behind it without closing them. If you bring one back three times in ten minutes, Core leaves it alone.
Dopo il risveglio Core verifica che la B: After a wake, Core checks that Big Picture is in front, that the TV is on Core's input and that the wired network works. If needed, it brings Big Picture back or repeats the input switch once.
BitLocker: il controllo della chiave di: BitLocker: checking the recovery key and the protection for firmware updates ask for administrator rights once, here on the desktop. Core never reads or stores the key; confirm the backup at account.microsoft.com/devices/recoverykey.
Accesso automatico: Core non salva passw: Automatic sign-in: Core stores no passwords. To set it up again, use Microsoft Sysinternals Autologon, which has Windows keep the password encrypted, and in Settings > Accounts > Sign-in options turn off Windows Hello-only sign-in.
BitLocker controllato. Il risultato è in: BitLocker checked. The result is in Quick Access > Core > Health.
Il controllo di BitLocker non è riuscito: The BitLocker check did not work or administrator permission was declined.
Protezione BitLocker attiva: prima di un: BitLocker protection on: before a firmware update, Core suspends BitLocker for one restart only.
Schermo, audio e controller normali dime: Normal display, sound and controllers forgotten.
Windows Home: nessun driver da Windows U: Windows Home: no device drivers from Windows Update
Gli aggiornamenti di funzionalità di Win: Windows feature updates stay on the current version
Backup dei salvataggi prima degli aggior: Save backup before the overnight updates, a reminder to save before bedtime, and the Steam collection Completed.
Prima del riavvio della notte degli aggi: Before the update-night restart and before an automatic Steam update, Ludusavi backs up every game's saves. Needs Ludusavi (winget install -e --id mtkennerly.ludusavi). If the backup fails, the update goes ahead anyway.
Mentre giochi, un avviso di Steam ricord: While you play, a Steam notification reminds you to save shortly before bedtime. Only a reminder: Core never closes the game.
Aggiungi i giochi completati alla raccol: Add completed games to the Completed collection
Quando un gioco di Steam arriva al 100%: When a Steam game reaches 100% of its achievements, Core adds it to your Steam collection named Completed. It never removes games from the collection.
Crea la raccolta Completed se manca: Create the Completed collection if it's missing
Senza questa opzione Core usa solo una r: Without this option Core only uses a Completed collection that already exists.
